q: What are your career goals for the next few years?
a:
My career goal for the next few years is to build a successful career in the aviation sector. I aim to become a senior cabin crew member at Qatar Airways.

I want to learn more about aviation and improve my skills in communication and teamwork.

I want to specialize in areas such as customer service and safety procedures.

Additionally, I hope to take on more responsibilities, such as training new staff. My goal is to be a valuable part of Qatar Airways and contribute to its success.
